name: Amal Holdings A.D. Ltd.
summary: Amal Holdings A.D. Ltd. provides nursing, rehabilitation, and care services in Israel. The company offers home care, senior housing, mental health, special education, and foster care; psychological treatment, counseling, diagnosis, and treatment; community mental health rehabilitation; consultation and preparation for insurance comities; preventive intervention for anxiety, distress, and post-traumatic stress services in children, as well as operates physiotherapy centers and educational frameworks. Amal Holdings A.D. Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is based in Caesarea, Israel.
